newsitem.title: USA: FBI arrests five militia members on bomb plot charge.
newsitem.headline: FBI arrests five militia members on bomb plot charge.

text.p: The FBI Friday arrested five militia members in West Virginia on charges of plotting to blow up the law enforcement agency's building in Clarksburg, West Virginia, federal officials said.
The officials said the five were taken into custody early Friday morning.
At issue in the alleged bomb plot was the FBI building in Clarksburg, which houses the agency's fingerprint files and crime statistics reporting unit.
Justice Department spokesman Bert Brandenburg declined comment on the case ahead of a news conference set for 1 p.m. EDT (1700 GMT) by the FBI in Clarksburg.
One federal official described it as a "fairly significant" militia case, but declined to give further details.
The last major militia case occurred in July, when federal authorities charged 12 members of an Arizona group with conspiring to blow up federal and local government buildings in the Phoenix area.
